title: Venty Cooling Unit
description:
Crafted for performance and comfort, the Venty Cooling Unit is designed to efficiently cool down and refine the vapor. This happens on two levels in the Cooling Unit to elongate the vapour path. A double-walled housing makes the Cooling Unit touchproof despite the high temperatures, and the extra screen within the Cooling Unit offers additional filtration to deliver a smooth and enjoyable session with every draw.

Includes 1* Venty Cooling Unit
